verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own card controls ('Smart Limits on cards', 'Control spend, automate compliance'), plus automated approvals and workspace rules. That covers the enforcement side of the story only thinly. Nothing in the pack shows allocating budgets to teams or projects, or tying limits and approvals to such budgets. missing for 10: budget allocation by team/project, enforcement of card limits against allocated budgets, approval workflows that check budgets, detailed docs on how Smart Limits work, independent or hands-on corroboration
